name: WataBuMe
source:
The protagonist is an eleven-year-old boy who lives in a small house with his parents. One day, the Grand Witch Subu appears and takes the protagonist away to make him her disciple. Despite his attempts to escape, he ends up at Subu's house, where he meets the witch's family.

After much thought, the protagonist decides to stay in that house, however, everything changes when a mysterious white silhouette appears in his path, making him begin to question his whole life.

What decisions will the protagonist make? Will he find the truth behind the strange silhouette? What secrets are Subu and her family hiding?

[Translated and Edited from [url=https://projectsakito.itch.io/watabume]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一个11岁的男孩，与父母住在一间小房子里。某天，大魔女Subu突然出现，将主人公带走，打算收他为徒。尽管试图逃跑，他最终还是来到了Subu的家，结识了魔女的家人。

经过一番思考，主人公决定留下。然而，一道神秘的白色身影出现在他面前，让他开始怀疑自己整个人生，一切也随之改变。

主人公将作出怎样的决定？他能查清那道诡异身影的真相吗？Subu与她的家人，又隐藏着什么秘密？

[根据[url=https://projectsakito.itch.io/watabume]itch.io[/url]内容翻译、编辑]
